zoe_pm: Quick check - we9re tweaking the paid cadence for the May webinar. Goal: registrations + build high-intent retarget pool. Short plan below.

- Channels: Search + Retarget Display. Soft start May 10 09:00 PT, 7-day test.
- Budget & pacing: $1,000/day initial. Ramp: 30% day1, 60% days2-4, 100% days5-7. Abort if CPA > $85 for 48h.
- Search: tCPA target $50. Enable DSA for long-tail. Brand exact bid +15%.
- Retarget: 14d window, two creative sets (Invite vs ROI), rotate every 72h, frequency cap 3/day. CPM target $5.50.
- Landing pages: full LP + micro-calendar LP for social. A/B hero copy: "Faster inference" vs "Lower inference cost". GA4 event webinar_reg.
- Routing: HubSpot list "MayWebPaid". lead.score >=60 -> auto task for SDR. Webhook endpoint will strip PII.

kai_ads: +1. Add: auto-pause bottom 3% CTR creatives every 48h, and a tiny brand-spend lift +$150/day for first 72h to measure uplift. I'll queue creative uploads.

maya_growth: Will wire GA4 and set conversion +paid_variant dimension. Also want to test thank-you calendar widget vs email-only for lift on demo requests.

leo_ops: I'll provision webhook and mock payloads by EOD. Ads-bot: drop campaign draft link when ready.

ads-bot: Draft campaign created: https://ads.internal/redwood/campaigns/1944 (draft).

zoe_pm: Action items: kai -> DSA + creative rules; maya -> GA4 & TY variants; leo -> webhook + QA. Review sync tomorrow 9:30 PT. Any blockers?
